explanation: With coarse dt~0.018 and sensor_noise~0.011, noisy angle/rate feedback causes mistimed forces (e.g. force ~13 at step 20 while theta~-0.64, omega~-3.19) that fail to arrest the fall, so theta diverges to -0.824 rad by step 24 exceeding 0.8 limit. Removing noise alone restores stability, confirming noise-induced destabilization at large dt.
